title: gibbsMap operation
description: Equilibrium map over a (T, P) grid by Gibbs minimisation: at every grid point the declared species set equilibrates over the element balance, and the declared metric (a species' mole fraction, an element's recovery) is contoured. The chart's pedagogical weapons are the two DECLARED boxes: an `industrialWindow` (where industry actually operates — for ammonia, NOT where equilibrium is best, because the catalyst rules) and a `kineticBand` (the user-declared region where kinetics kill the approach), both watermarked with their labels so the map says why the plant is not at the thermodynamic optimum.

species.title: Species set
species.description: `( { name N2; atoms ( 2 0 ); } ... )` — each species with its atom counts in the declared element order.

feed.title: Feed moles
feed.description: `{ N2 1.0; H2 3.0; }` — the element inventory comes from this.

Pgrid.title: Pressure grid
Pgrid.description: `{ from ...; to ...; n ...; log true; }` — `log` spaces the axis logarithmically, the natural spacing for a pressure map.

metric.title: Contoured metric
metric.description: What each grid point reports: `{ type moleFraction; species NH3; }` or an element-recovery metric with `element`.

temperatureApproach.title: Equilibrium approach magnitude (direction assigned by the engine)
temperatureApproach.description: Detune the equilibrium by THIS MANY kelvin at every cell of the map — the standard admission that a real reactor does not reach it; announced when non-zero. THE VALUE IS A MAGNITUDE AND THE ENGINE ASSIGNS THE SIGN AT EACH CELL (ruled 2026-09-26, the same rule and the same code as gibbsReactor): T + dT where the overall transformation at that cell's T is exothermic, T − dT where it is endothermic, with the tally of solves per direction announced and published (approachDirection_*Solves) and each cell's SIGNED value in the CSV's deltaT_K column. A negative declaration is REFUSED by name; minimum 0 is that rule. The anchor KPI names carry the declared magnitude (_dT<n>). It is EMPIRICAL (calibrated against a real unit, never predicted) and GLOBAL (one number; it cannot resolve per-reaction approaches, so the OVERALL thermicity decides the direction), and at high pressure it will absorb missing fugacity corrections. (The 2026-09-25 description said the sign was the author's and deliberately had no lower bound; superseded by the ruling.)

industrialWindow.title: Labelled (T, P) box
industrialWindow.description: A rectangle drawn on the map with its label — raw SI (K, Pa).

kineticBand.title: Labelled (T, P) box
kineticBand.description: A rectangle drawn on the map with its label — raw SI (K, Pa).

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.

anchors.title: Published anchor points
anchors.description: `( { T ...; P ...; } ... )` — (T, P) points where a published value exists; the run reports the computed metric at each so the whole map is pinned to literature at its corners, not just plausible.
